central_question: Why do AI benchmarks repeat the same old index problem in a new technological costume?

verified_claims.claim: Stanford HAI’s AI Index tracks, collates, distills and visualizes data related to artificial intelligence for policymakers, researchers, executives, journalists and the public.
SWE-bench evaluates language models on real-world GitHub issues by asking a model to generate a patch for a described problem.
Government AI readiness rankings are index-like policy tools and should be read cautiously because they compress institutional, technology and data conditions.

myth_or_uncertainty_notes: Avoid model-score current claims unless refreshed.
Do not treat leaderboard ranking as general intelligence.
visual_opportunities: [VISUAL: benchmark leaderboard as modern index metaphor]
prohibited_or_unsupported_claims: AI benchmarks measure intelligence in general.
A single leaderboard score proves real-world capability.
